name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native & Template Space) - qMRI
summary: Maps quantitative MRI maps (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF) onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native and template (MNI) space with Connectome Workbench, with b0 SNR masking, as a cortexmap.
description: Builds GIFTI surfaces from FreeSurfer and samples each available qMRI map within the cortical ribbon onto the midthickness surface, following Fukutomi et al. (2018). Vertices with low b0 temporal SNR (computed from the DWI) are masked out. A nonlinear warp is used to also produce template-space (MNI) surfaces. Requires a FreeSurfer license; the qMRI maps must be aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvals/bvecs; used only to compute a b0 temporal SNR map (mean/std of the b0 volumes) for masking low-SNR cortical vertices.
inputs.requirements: Must contain several b0 volumes (needed to compute the b0 standard deviation) and be in the same space as the measure volumes.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output directory of the same subject; the white and pial surfaces, ribbon.mgz, brain.finalsurfs.mgz and the chosen .annot parcellation are read from it.
Optional brain mask in DWI space used to mask the SNR map; if missing, one is computed with FSL bet on the mean b0.
Quantitative MRI maps (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF); each map present is mapped to the cortical surface.
Nonlinear warp and inverse warp to a template space (usually MNI), e.g. from the FSL Anat App; used to also produce template-space (mni) surfaces.
inputs.requirements: The mapping script reads config key inverse_warp while the registry supplies inverse-warp, so template-space surfaces may fail; see report.

inputs.description: Optional existing cortexmap from a previous run; if it contains native midthickness surfaces, its surf, label and func files are copied and the new measures are added to it.

outputs.description: cortexmap with the qMRI maps mapped to the surface in func/, plus the GIFTI surfaces in surf/ and parcellation labels in label/.
Intermediate derivatives (measure volumes, ribbon masks, SNR images, c_ras transform) kept for QA and debugging.

parameters.description: FreeSurfer surface parcellation (.annot) converted to GIFTI label files and written to the cortexmap label folder.

citations.text: Fukutomi H, et al. Neurite imaging reveals microstructural variations in human cerebral cortical gray matter. NeuroImage (2018).
Glasser MF, Sotiropoulos SN, Wilson JA, et al. The minimal preprocessing pipelines for the Human Connectome Project. NeuroImage 80:105-124 (2013).

failure_modes.cause: The b0 SNR image could not be mapped to the cortical surface.
failure_modes.fix: Check that the DWI has multiple b0 volumes and is aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy.
